❌ Legacy SIP Feature-Caps Failure Modes (RFC 6809 / RFC 3840)

+g.3gpp.atcf="<sip:evil.example>" or +sip.srs to hijack call/recording URIs.
2. Media-Relay Anchor Bypass: Spoofed upstream anchor capability tricks

leaks internal proxy URIs and bloats UDP INVITE packets past 1,300 bytes.

✅ Deterministic P991–P992 🎉 (1,000+ Guardrails!) Feature-Caps Gate

2. P992 🎉 (🎉 1,001st Guard / 1,010th Probe / 820th POC) Anchor Lock:

3. Egress Topology Scrubbing: Remove internal Feature-Caps headers
before forwarding SIP messages outside the enterprise mTLS trust domain.
